description: Actual B737-8 Explorer release model rendered in Blender for the portfolio archive; no generated substitute aircraft or retouched geometry.
renderChanges: Temporary three-quarter camera, pale neutral studio ground and broad area lights. Aircraft geometry and the source Blender file were unchanged.
provenance: The project combines a user-supplied aircraft, adapted FlightGear meshes, authored geometry and CC0 materials. Component rights and source credits remain separate; this is an independent visualization, not an airline or manufacturer commission.
